what: CDW resells information technology to organisations. It sells hardware, software and cloud services from thousands of vendors and helps customers choose, install and manage them.
customers: Businesses, government agencies, schools and healthcare organisations in the United States, United Kingdom and Canada.
moat: Relationships with thousands of vendors and tens of thousands of customers, where its account managers become the trusted buying channel for everything technical.
risks: Gross margin of 22% reflects a distribution business
Hardware refresh cycles are lumpy and were pulled forward during the pandemic
Revenue has fallen about 2% a year over three years
opportunities: Revenue grew about 7% last year with return on invested capital of 15%
An ageing installed base of PCs and servers is due for replacement
Services and cloud resale earn better margins than hardware
watch: Net sales growth by customer segment and gross profit margin.
